raw: https://e-hentai.org/g/4082982/45f13c4415/

Another commission, yay! By our amazing regular commissioner, lzzy!

Imagine being a lesbian/trans-guy with a super pervy mind, getting abducted by some aliens who give you a dick, inmortality, eternal youth and more, and ask you to marry them... furthermore, this alien has multiple bodies, so, you kind of get your own ..."pseudo-harem" too (though all of those belonng to the same entity)? furthermore, said alien has a genetical-level urge to fanatically dote on you, (and actually has no problem with letting you try out the other aliens too, if you wish so.) plus they can pretty much ass-pull whatever you desire... ...though I can't help but wonder if Ichigo's sanity will survive... but if we ignore that for a second, what else could one ask for~? (just kidding. XD or not...?)

So, something to add, I took a bit of liberty at where the alien introduced themselves, because originally they did not clearly state they're the captain, nor that they're one entity with multiple bodies. However, their grammar quirks, along with all the things that happen in the doujin makes me think that,
1.) they are some sort of authority, if they were the first to look for and get their "bridegroom"
2.) we clearly see multiple aliens with the exact same looks, who talk and behave in such odd ways that all things considered (and because almost anything can happen in sci-fi and fantasy) my assumption is that it's one entity with multiple bodies - but there are also other aliens on the ship who are separate entities, and look different - they talk similar in regards of always referring to themselves in plural, so I think it's a racial trait, and they have multiple bodies too, just not present at that scene.
although the raw did not clarify either of these, I thought stating them outright would help readers understanding what the heck's going on, because, certainly this doujin is fairly unusual XD

But for sure, that's such a fascinating idea that can work easily in sci-fi, and, I don't think I ever seen it used in hentai before. very creative! ...unlike the alien race's naming... XD lol "Huge and Plump Aliens" ...Well, I guess it's on point XD lol
Oh, also, these creatures aren't actually emotionless either, but their face doesn't represent their emotions, it seems. It's also unclear if they're some sort of slime-like aliens, because they don't really look like that, though the captain did "tuck up" Ichigo part-inside their own body for a bit... (I decided to have them say "core" instead of "heart" since it was ambigous, but don't draw any conclusions from that.
Either way, highly fascinating lifeforms~ let's just hope that our kinky little futa keeps at least some of her sanity... XD

Anyway, enough blabbering, right?
I hope you enjoy reading it~!
